question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Imperial
solution:
The correct answer is **Sovereign**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Imperial** means connected with an empire or its ruler.

 ** -Example:** During the British **imperial** period, India suffered greatly at the expense of their treatment.

 
• Marked option **Sovereign** means having the highest possible authority.

 **-Example:** Yet Greece was the **sovereign** power in all the world of ancient culture.

So, it is clear that** Imperial **and **Sovereign** are similar in meaning.

​Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Paternal** means related through the father’s side of the family.
 
• **God-fearing **means having a reverent feeling toward God : **devout**.
 
• **Ancestral **means relating or inherited from an ancestor's ancestral estates.
